publisher: Junta de Planificación de Puerto Rico (JP)
filter: municipio = 'Arecibo' AND barrio IN ('Domingo Ruíz','Esperanza','Factor','Florida Adentro','Garrochales','Hato Abajo','Hato Arriba','Hato Viejo')
notes: JP statewide calificacion layer (cali_vige) filtered to municipio Arecibo, part B of 3 split by barrio because the full municipio (~44k parcel-level features) is too slow to read in one pass. zone = cali, zone_name = descrip.
